_comment: Board -> SVD mapping + per-board metadata for Register Inspector. All board-specific knowledge lives here + in the SVD files, never hardcoded in C++. See docs/register_inspector_plan.md (Bolum 3.3, 4.3). Adding a new board = drop its .svd here + add a record below.

gdb.notes: ST-Link VCP (UART/COM port) durur SWD oturumu acikken (ST-Link FW V3J16M9); hedef cekirdek etkilenmez (DHCSR S_HALT=0, S_RETIRE_ST=1 boyunca dogrulandi) - bu ST-Link probe kaynagi paylasimi, cekirdek durmasi degil. UART, link kapanir kapanmaz aninda devam eder. Ayrica: gdbserver sureci duzgun kapandiktan (tasklist ile dogrulandi) sonra bile STM32_Programmer_CLI bir sureligine DEV_USB_COMM_ERR verebilir; fiziksel USB replug ile aninda duzelir - ST-Link firmware/surucu tuhafligi, kod tarafinda kaynak sizintisi degil.

boards.notes: TrustZone/RIF: HOTPLUG may fail on secured firmware (can't get core ID). Fallback: mode=UR reset+snapshot (NOT live state). See plan Bolum 3.4 and docs/n6_kaldigimiz_yer.md. Faz 0 N6 checklist still deferred until board is on hand.

gdb.notes: TrustZone/RIF: guvenli RAM bolgeleri non-secure DAP'tan okunamaz; okuma hatasi olarak yuzeye cikar, sessiz sifir DONMEZ. LRUN boot sonrasi -g attach dogrulanmadi.
